paper_title: Efficient Ensemble for Fine-tuning Language Models on Multiple Datasets
caption: We measure the average similarity between models fine-tuned on random subsets S and single-task models. We observe that the similarity score becomes lower as the size of S increases.

model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the cosine similarity for two different methods, "Weight averaging" and "QAdapter," across varying values of a parameter denoted as $|S|$. The x-axis is labeled "$|S|$," features a linear scale with a plotted value range from 2 to 10, and has major numeric tick labels spaced at an interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Cosine similarity," utilizes a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to just above 0.5, and displays numeric tick labels at an interval of 0.2. The plot contains two lines detailing the values for each method. The line representing "Weight averaging" is plotted in blue with square markers and a dashed line style; it exhibits a continuous decline across the x-axis, beginning at its highest plotted value of approximately 0.48 at $|S|=2$ and decreasing steadily to approximately 0.32 at $|S|=10$. The line representing "QAdapter" is depicted in green with circular markers and a dashed line style; it similarly demonstrates a downward trend, starting at roughly 0.38 at $|S|=2$, declining to approximately 0.22 at $|S|=6$, and subsequently leveling off to end at approximately 0.21 at $|S|=10$.
model_annotations.German: This plot illustrates the relationship between Cosine similarity and the value of |S| for two different methods: Weight averaging and QAdapter. The x-axis is labeled "|S|" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2 to 10, with numeric tick labels provided at an interval of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Cosine similarity" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to just above 0.5, with numeric tick labels set at an interval of 0.2. The line representing "Weight averaging" is plotted in blue with a dashed line style and square markers. It exhibits a steady, gradual decline across the x-axis, starting at a maximum value of approximately 0.48 at an |S| value of 2 and decreasing consistently to end at a minimum value of roughly 0.31 when |S| is 10. The line representing "QAdapter" is plotted in green with a dashed line style and circular markers. It follows a downward trajectory, beginning at approximately 0.38 at an |S| value of 2, experiencing a drop to roughly 0.29 at an |S| value of 3, and then continuing to decline more gradually to end at a minimum value of 0.2 when |S| reaches 10.
